claude.rationale: This is a whole-entity balance-sheet reorganization: Arch Coal, Inc. continued as the same Delaware legal entity, and the customer-facing coal-mining business (T4) carried forward together with its full executive-officer layer running day-to-day operations (T5), which "carried forward unchanged" — so product and processes moved together, and gap_45 is 0. T5 processes were not carved out or re-engineered apart from the people running them; every existing executive officer continued in the same role, so operations and their management/organization stayed aligned, making gap_56 0. Controlling equity shifted (94% to former secured lenders) and nine of ten directors were replaced, driving T1=replace and T6=partial (governance replaced but operating management/culture retained); the slice explicitly notes no transitional-services/operating agreement, consistent with no carve-out gap.
